stages.rule: Never rescale horizontal geography to fit an artistic composition.
No invented elevation between missing source cells; mark gaps.
Origin and transform come from terrain-authority.json.
One canonical terrain mesh shared by every era.
No vertical exaggeration in authority data; presentation exaggeration is a reversible view parameter.
Check ridge/valley relationships and route elevation profile before publication.

runtime.lod: derive lower-resolution display meshes from canonical grid; never create separate historical terrains
runtime.integration: Three.js historical objects and routes consume the same ENU frame. MapLibre-compatible terrain/elevation queries may be used as verification, not as a second coordinate authority.

acceptance: Mount of Olives higher than Kidron approach in the route profile.
Jerusalem ridge rises west of Kidron.
Temple/Haram platform anchor is spatially stable through all temporal states.
Scrubbing time changes objects, not terrain vertices.
